mapper.select: select ss.id as series_submission_id, ss.match_series_id, ms.series_code, ms.best_of, d.division_name, ht.team_name_snapshot as home_team_name, at.team_name_snapshot as away_team_name, st.team_name_snapshot as submit_team_name, ss.declared_home_win_count, ss.declared_away_win_count, ss.actual_game_count, ss.version_no, ss.status, ss.submit_time, ss.audit_time from basket_match_series_submission ss join basket_match_series ms on ms.id = ss.match_series_id and ms.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = ss.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team ht on ht.id = ms.home_event_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team at on at.id = ms.away_event_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team st on st.id = ss.submit_event_team_id and st.is_delete = 0 where ss.is_delete = 0 and ss.season_id = #{seasonId} and ss.division_id = #{divisionId} and ss.match_series_id = #{matchSeriesId} and ss.status = #{status} and (ht.team_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%') or at.team_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%')) and ms.series_code like concat('%', #{seriesCode}, '%') order by case when ss.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' then 0 else 1 end, ss.submit_time desc, ss.id desc
